newsitem.title: MACEDONIA: SOCCER-POPESCU HITS HAT-TRICK AS ROMANIA BEAT MACEDONIA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-POPESCU HITS HAT-TRICK AS ROMANIA BEAT MACEDONIA.

text.p: Barcelona midfielder Gheorghe Popescu scored a hat-trick as Romania swept Macedonia aside 3-0 in a group eight World Cup qualifier on Saturday.
Popescu, thriving at Barcelona this season after his transfer from English side Tottenham, opened the scoring after 37 minutes and added his second on the stroke of half-time.
He completed his hat-trick from the penalty spot in injury time.
Romania dominated the match despite the abscence of key players including inspirational forward Gheorghe Hagi, West Ham's Ilie Dumitrescu and Galatasaray forward Adrian Ilie.
They are now top of group eight with three wins from their first three games.
